newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market rates little changed.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market rates little changed.

text.p: Swiss money market rates were quoted little changed from Tuesday, with tomorrow/next money quoted around 1-3/8 percent, traders said.
Traders did not see the Swiss National Bank adding significant liquidity to the money market this morning at its usual time for early operations of 0700 GMT.
Traders said the SNB has recently been adding regularly to the market. One trader also noted that call money is still below the 1.50 percent discount rate.
